title: Incident intake
idea: Incident intake: Immediate safety guidance precedes a concise factual intake with evidence consent and submission recovery.
audience: People who need to report incident within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: A person must report an issue without navigating a full workspace.
avoidWhen: The interface would imply guaranteed emergency response.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its report incident priority and explicit commitment contract: Acknowledge only actual receipt and describe realistic next steps and limitations.
navigation: Incident intake keeps the current report incident context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Immediate safety guidance precedes a concise factual intake with evidence consent and submission recovery.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to report incident; a person must report an issue without navigating a full workspace.
composition.priority: Acknowledge only actual receipt and describe realistic next steps and limitations.

imagery.role: Support the actual report incident context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize safety and short required fields; make attachment upload optional and recoverable.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the incident intake structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no report incident content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Acknowledge only actual receipt and describe realistic next steps and limitations.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized report incident content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Acknowledge only actual receipt and describe realistic next steps and limitations.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active report incident context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
